reconstruction_note: The post published 2026-06-30. The original ad-hoc harness lived in a gitignored tmp/ scratch dir and was cleaned up after publication; the firsthand record (firsthand-benchmark.md) was preserved. exp.ts here is reconstructed from that record and re-run live on 2026-08-03 against the SAME pinned ai@6.0.212 + zod@4.4.3. Because the harness makes ZERO model calls (MockLanguageModelV3), the result is deterministic and every recorded assertion reproduced exactly. This is a genuine live run, not a paper reconstruction — hence backfilled:false.

environment.note: The probe drives the SDK's agent loop with a scripted mock language model (0 network calls). It observes control flow — step counts, tool-error feedback parts, structured-output throws, the ToolLoopAgent default stopWhen cap. These are pinned by the SDK version, not by CPU/GPU/RAM, so hardware is intentionally omitted. Node version affects only meta.node, not the experiment values.

subject.name: Vercel AI SDK 6 — agent tool loop, structured output, and the v5 to v6 maxSteps removal
subject.source: npm ai@6.0.212 (Experimental_Agent / ToolLoopAgent, generateText, generateObject, stepCountIs, hasToolCall) and ai/test MockLanguageModelV3
subject.note: All subject versions are pinned exactly (no ^ ranges, no latest). A fresh npm install of ai@6.0.212 reproduces the committed probe-result.json.

baseline.name: Vercel AI SDK 5 mental model (maxSteps-driven loop)
baseline.note: Two v6 assertions are framed as deltas from v5: maxSteps is no longer exported or honored (loop control moved entirely to stopWhen), and the agent class default stopWhen is stepCountIs(20).

fixture.design: 13 experiments across 5 groups: API surface (class identity, maxSteps removal), loop control (stopWhen present/absent/hasToolCall), tool-error self-heal (execute throws, ghost tool), structured-output boundaries (valid / schema violation / non-JSON), and the ToolLoopAgent wrapper + its default 20-step cap. Each experiment reads a concrete field of the SDK's return value (steps.length, text, content part types, error class).

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: node_modules is NOT committed (gitignored) — run.sh reinstalls the pinned deps. The deterministic evidence probe-result.json IS committed.
raw_artifacts.note: probe-result.json holds the full 13-experiment matrix. Re-running run.sh with ai@6.0.212 regenerates it identically (except meta.node, which reflects the local Node).
